summary: Phase D (Billing + 7-day Trial + Tier gating + Stripe + Apple IAP + Expired paywall) tested end-to-end against the public preview URL. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass (test_phase_d_billing.py). CRITICAL frontend bug found and fixed at app/(tabs)/index.tsx:64-65 — a leftover empty IIFE `(() => {}).catch(() => {});` crashed the Discover tab with `TypeError: (intermediate value).catch is not a function` and triggered the red screen for every logged-in user before any further UI could be exercised; removed the dead IIFE and Expo rebooted clean. After the fix, upgrade flow + Stripe checkout + Apple confirm modal + billing-success verified. Two frontend issues remain: (1) the trial `trial_days_left` display on Discover shows 'Free trial · 0 days left' for a freshly-registered user even though GET /api/auth/me returns trial_days_left=7 (verified in test_auth_me_access tests). (2) The Discover tab (and the whole PlanGate flow) does NOT render the paywall for an expired user — Analyze/Portfolio/Alerts correctly show the paywall but Discover still renders the full screener. Likely cause: usePlan() in src/plans.tsx promotes `tier` to `rcTier` whenever `TIER_RANK[rcTier] > TIER_RANK[tier]`, and on the web Browser Mode RevenueCat gives the anonymous ID a non-expired tier that overrides the backend 'expired' tier for the primary Discover route (other screens may re-check differently). Also, the pay-apple button is disabled with 'App Store options unavailable right now' because the RevenueCat Browser Mode user has no package in the current offering, so tapping it does NOT open the confirm-apple/cancel-apple modal — the modal only opens when a package is available. Per the agent-to-agent note this may be the intended behaviour on web, but worth confirming. Backend coverage: /auth/me access block (tier/trial_days_left/trial_ends_at/source/renews_at); /billing/status features matrix + scans_today + alerts_count (trial has scans_per_day=5, advance has smart_alerts+collateral_views+ai_explain+backtest, scans_per_day=INF); fresh register => tier 'trial' with 6-7 days; mongo-backdated 8-day-old user with plan None => tier 'expired' trial_days_left 0; POST /user/plan {plan:'expert'|'advance'} => 402, {plan:'free'} => 200, invalid => 400; /billing/downgrade => 200; POST /billing/stripe/checkout {plan:'advance'} returns real https://checkout.stripe.com URL + cs_test_* session_id, invalid plan => 400; GET /billing/stripe/status/{sid} returns paid:false for unpaid session, 404 for unknown session_id; POST /screener/best-options tier:'simple' => allowed_strategies == {'Cash Secured Put','Covered Call'}, tier:'advance' => no naked strategies (no Sell Put/Sell Call/Short Strangle); scans_today increments by 1 between calls. Frontend coverage (mobile 390x844): login as trader@optiscreen.app (advance) => Profile ▸ profile-upgrade navigates to /upgrade; /upgrade renders upgrade-plan-{simple,advance,expert} with correct prices ($9/$29/$79), upgrade-current shows 'Current: Advance', pay-card opens real Stripe checkout (navigated to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_...), pay-paypal + restore-purchases present, pay-apple disabled on web (no RC package). /billing-success?cancelled=1 renders 'Payment cancelled' + billing-continue. Onboarding /plan screen (fresh user with plan=null) renders '7-day free trial' card plus Simple/Advance/Expert cards with 'Monthly · auto-renews' tags and 'Start free trial' CTA. Trial user Discover shows profile-low_low/low_high/high_high + locked-custom. Expired user: /analyze /portfolio /alerts all show paywall + paywall-upgrade (navigates to /upgrade). Deprecated packages detected: NONE. SafeAreaView issues detected: NONE. No React Native red screen after fix. The seed trader user is left on plan 'advance' with plan_source null and plan_expires_at null as required.

ui_bugs.issue: scan-usage shows 'Free trial · 0 days left' for a freshly registered trial user; backend /api/auth/me returns trial_days_left=7. Likely the Discover subtitle uses a stale/incorrect field or a 0-day fallback. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (scan-usage text).

integration_issues.issue: PlanGate does NOT block the Discover tab for an expired user even though /analyze /portfolio /alerts correctly show the paywall. Likely cause: usePlan() in /app/frontend/src/plans.tsx:41 promotes `tier` to `rcTier` whenever TIER_RANK[rcTier] > TIER_RANK[tier]. On web Browser Mode the anonymous RevenueCat ID may resolve to a non-expired tier that silently overrides the backend 'expired' tier. Fix: only honor rcTier when source is identity-ready AND the backend-reported tier is paid/trial — never let it upgrade past 'expired'.

Tapping pay-apple on web does not open confirm-apple/cancel-apple modal because the button is disabled when rcPackage is missing (expected on Browser Mode / Test Store). Review spec says the confirm modal should still appear 'labelled simulated'. Fix: show the confirm modal even without a package, or stub a package in Browser Mode so the test flow matches the spec.

action_items: Investigate trial_days_left=0 display on Discover for a freshly-registered trial user (expected 7). GET /api/auth/me returns the correct value — fix the Discover component to source trial_days_left from auth.user.access.trial_days_left (same as /upgrade uses) instead of whatever derivation currently returns 0.

Fix PlanGate so an expired backend tier is NEVER promoted by RevenueCat Browser Mode. Suggested patch in src/plans.tsx usePlan(): `if (rcTier && TIER_RANK[rcTier] > TIER_RANK[tier] && tier !== 'expired') { tier = rcTier; source = 'app_store'; }` — or require source==='app_store' + identityReady AND an active entitlement before applying rcTier.

Make pay-apple open the confirm-apple/cancel-apple modal even on web / Test Store with no RC package (stub a simulated package, or allow confirm with a placeholder), so the documented 'simulated' confirm flow is reachable.
Remove the dead IIFE pattern anywhere else in the codebase: `(() => {}).catch(() => {})` was crashing Discover; grep for `.catch(() => {});` after an IIFE to be safe.
critical_code_review_comments: billing.compute_access correctly derives tier from created_at + plan + plan_expires_at and returns {tier, trial_days_left, trial_ends_at, source, renews_at, features, prices} — backend contract is clean.
POST /user/plan correctly returns 402 for any paid plan ('simple'/'advance'/'expert') so clients must go through Stripe/PayPal/App Store — matches the review spec.

/billing/stripe/checkout creates a real test-mode subscription session with monthly recurring price_data, stores a payment_transactions doc with status 'initiated', and the /status/{session_id} endpoint is idempotent (only grants plan on first paid=True observation). Good.
/billing/stripe/status returns 404 for unknown session_id but allows paid=false for a valid-but-unpaid session — correct behaviour for the polling pattern used by upgrade.tsx and billing-success.tsx.

Screener /best-options tier gating via _tier_allows + candidate_strategies: simple => Cash Secured Put + Covered Call only; advance => no naked (Sell Put/Sell Call/Short Strangle); scans_today bumps per request. Verified end-to-end.

CRITICAL FIX (applied): app/(tabs)/index.tsx line 64-65 had `(() => {}).catch(() => {});` which crashed the entire Discover tab (TypeError: (intermediate value).catch is not a function). Removed the dead IIFE. The ErrorBoundary 'Something went wrong — Reload app' screen was reproducible on every reload before the fix.

upgrade.tsx hard-disables pay-apple when !rcPackage || !sub.identityReady, so on web Browser Mode (where the current offering has no package) the entire Apple purchase + confirm modal flow is unreachable. The review spec expects the simulated confirm modal to appear.

src/plans.tsx usePlan() unconditionally promotes tier to rcTier when its rank is higher — this bypasses the backend 'expired' state as soon as RevenueCat reports any non-expired tier, breaking the paywall on Discover. Needs the guard described in action_items.
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway users created for UI testing: test_trial_ui_dade0c3a@optiscreen.app (plan=free, created_at=now, tier trial) and test_expired_ui_b0f082e3@optiscreen.app (plan=free, created_at=10 days ago, tier expired). Backend pytest run also creates/deletes test_trial_* and test_expired_* users and leaves the trader@optiscreen.app seed on plan 'advance' (plan_source=null, plan_expires_at=null) as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend billing contract is fully green (17/17). The two outstanding frontend bugs are both in the gating/display layer, not the backend. (1) Discover 'Free trial · 0 days left' should read 7 for a freshly-registered trial user — compare with how /upgrade's upgrade-current label correctly shows '7 days left'. (2) Expired user should see the paywall on Discover too (currently only Analyze/Portfolio/Alerts enforce it) — the fix is a guard in src/plans.tsx usePlan() to prevent rcTier from overriding 'expired'. Also the pay-apple button should allow the simulated confirm modal to appear even when no RC package is available on web. The red-screen crash on Discover caused by the empty IIFE at app/(tabs)/index.tsx:64-65 has already been fixed in this iteration. Credentials: trader@optiscreen.app / TestPass123! (advance). Create new trial/expired users via POST /api/auth/register and backdate created_at in Mongo for expired testing (see /app/backend/tests/test_phase_d_billing.py expired_user fixture).
rca_of_issue: Red-screen crash RCA: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx had a dead empty IIFE `(() => {}).catch(() => {})` at line 64-65 (likely a leftover from a refactor). The IIFE returns undefined, so `.catch(...)` throws TypeError at render time inside useEffect, bubbling up to the ErrorBoundary and preventing any further UI (login, profile, upgrade, etc.) from being reached. Reproduction: load any route while logged in — immediate 'Something went wrong — Reload app' screen with console error '(intermediate value).catch is not a function'. Mitigation: deleted the dead IIFE. Verified by reloading all routes (Discover, Profile, /upgrade, /billing-success?cancelled=1) — no red screens, Discover renders normally, Stripe checkout opens, scan-usage/profile-* elements all mount.
